summary_en: The study tests enasidenib, a drug that targets the IDH2 gene mutation, in rare cancers of the nasal cavity or skull base that have an IDH2 mutation. Enasidenib is taken by mouth once a day, every day, in 28-day cycles with no rest between cycles. Participants may stay in the study as long as the drug is helping them. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: El estudio prueba enasidenib, un medicamento dirigido a la mutación del gen IDH2, en cánceres raros de la cavidad nasal o de la base del cráneo que tienen una mutación de IDH2. El enasidenib se toma por vía oral una vez al día, todos los días, en ciclos de 28 días sin periodos de descanso entre ciclos. Los participantes pueden permanecer en el estudio mientras el medicamento les esté ayudando. El desenlace principal no se indica en el registro; este es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Locally advanced or metastatic chondrosarcoma, sinonasal adenocarcinoma, large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, olfactory neuroblastoma, or sinonasal undifferenti
Tumor has an IDH2 mutation, R140 or R172, with a primary tumor in the sinonasal cavity or skull base.
ECOG performance status 0-2 and adequate blood, liver and kidney function.
not_for: Prior treatment with an IDH1 or IDH2 inhibitor.
Systemic anticancer treatment within 3 weeks before the first dose.
New or progressive brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
Clinically significant heart disease, or QTc above 450 msec.
